AC-3: The current-truth ledger names every external band with accepted owner, typed phase, exact replacement revision where terminal, exact evidence refs, manifest-admission status, retained-file authority, rollback rule, and no-deferral boundary

AC-4: A future canonically ordered immutable deletion manifest binds each candidate to normalized repo-relative path, baseline object identity, measured lines, capability, authority-rooted reachability, accepted replacement owner, exact revision, terminal receipt, proof references, disposition, and manifest digest

AC-5: The #5347 manifest has zero canonical path overlap with the exact reviewed #5346 language/compiler/engine/CLI manifest; ambiguous, mixed-owner, nonterminal, or consumer-dependent rows fail closed as blocked

AC-6: Every delete_external row has accepted replacement behavior and negative proof; every retained row names owner, consumer, rationale, proof role, and sunset condition; missing, stale, metadata-only, GitHub-only, fixture-only, or nonterminal evidence blocks deletion

AC-7: Product paths are added only by typed claim amendment after manifest freeze, disjointness proof, dependency proof, and review; deletion touches exactly tracked manifest files and rejects traversal, symlink escape, duplicates, submodules, generated output, and untracked files

AC-8: Focused owner tests, characterization/parity, security/determinism negatives, selector rollback, current CI, consumer reachability, rollback proof, budget accounting, and post-deletion validation pass at exact revisions with deterministic redacted repo-relative evidence and no deferred acceptance
AC-9: Runtime v2, ADL v2, Runtime v3, C-SDLC v2, #5346 core paths, selector/cutover state, and historical non-executable evidence remain outside #5347 mutation authority

AC-10: The later implementation reuses Git, typed C-SDLC v2, existing characterization/parity tools, and standard JSON parsing; manifest/gate code stays within 500 nonblank lines, tests/fixtures within 800 lines and fewer than 50 tests, retained evidence within 1,200 lines, focused gates within 120/300 seconds, complete proof within 3,600 seconds, and net source change is negative with separate accounting
